text: . Indian Sugar and Bio-energy Manufacturers Association (ISMA) Director General Deepak Ballani today said, sugar prices are likely to cool off as panic and speculative buying ease, with sufficient stocks available in the country. He said, the rise in sugar prices over the past 20 days was driven by speculative and panic buying. Mr Ballani was talking to a news agency on the sidelines of the ISMA Press Conference in National Capital.  He asserted that there are absolutely no problems with sugar availability in the country. On ethanol, Mr Ballani rejected suggestions that diversion of sugar towards ethanol was responsible for the recent price increase adding that domestic consumption remains the first priority.ISMA President Niraj Shirgaokar said the association has sought a reduction in the sugar holding limit for traders from 400 tonnes to 200 tonnes so that more stocks are released into the retail market. He said the government has taken several measures over the past four to six months, including physical verification of stocks at sugar mills and limits on traders, institutional buyers and bulk consumers. Mr Shirgaokar said the government has announced imports of 10 lakh tonnes of sugar as a precautionary measure to ensure comfortable availability.

. Prime Minister Narendra Modi has said that the government is fully committed to creating a modern sports ecosystem for India in the 21st century. He said that, from sports universities to modern training centres, an ecosystem is being developed across the country where talent receives support at every stage.Addressing the Khelo India Dialogue through video conferencing today, Mr Modi said that sports is not limited merely to winning medals, rather, it is a mission to unite India’s sporting prowess and youth power in the building of a developed India. He said every district has the potential to shine on the global sports map.The Prime Minister said he had announced from the ramparts of the Red Fort that a big talent hunt to identify kids from 5 to 15 years of age in sports. He emphasised the need to focus not only on the sport a child is interested in but also on identifying the sport they are best suited for. The Prime Minister assured to provide all possible support from the government for this.The Prime Minister expressed happiness that today sports has emerged as an excellent career and profession in India. Mr Modi said sports does not just teach to become champions but also to become better competitors. He said, ‘The Khelo India Samvad is not merely a program for discussing sports, but it is a platform for dialogue where every single idea can give a new direction to the nation’s sports vision. ‘Prime Minister said that these new ideas from the power of the country’s youth will become the strength that helps realise the vision of Viksit Bharat.Speaking on the occasion, Union Minister for Youth Affairs and Sports Mansukh Mandaviya said that under the leadership of Prime Minister Modi, sports has emerged as a national priority and an important instrument of youth empowerment. He said India’s sports ecosystem is now moving beyond infrastructure and medals as initiatives such as the Fit India Movement and Sunday on Cycle encourage citizens to make fitness a part of everyday life.The Minister said that the National Sports Governance Act is promoting transparency and accountability and strengthening fair opportunities in sports so that talented sportspersons receive an equal platform to demonstrate their abilities. Dr Mandaviya said the government’s approach is aimed at making India’s youth active partners in the journey towards a Viksit Bharat.The Programme was organised as part of the National Sports Day 2026 celebrations by Mera Yuva Bharat (MY Bharat). It was conducted across the country with participation of youth at two colleges in every district across States and Union Territories. The event brought together sports, youth leadership, civic responsibility, volunteering, fitness and nation-building on a common platform.The Khelo India Dialogue provided a direct channel for young people to engage with the country’s sporting ambitions while ensuring that their ideas and perspectives become part of the continuing conversation on India’s youth and sports ecosystem. The Khelo India Dialogue is being held in line with Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s vision of building a fit, disciplined and sporting nation and placing the aspirations of youth at the centre of the national development agenda.

. The External Affairs Ministry has informed that 21 Indian nationals from Tamil Nadu, who travelled for the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra, have been rescued in Nepal. Meanwhile, India has stepped up efforts to trace and rescue Indian nationals stranded in Nepal due to flash flood tragedy. Addressing media in New Delhi today, External Affairs Ministry spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal said that contact has not been established with 288 Indian nationals who were present in Nepal when the tragedy occurred. It include 73 Indians who were working on the Trishuli-1 power project. He said, the Indian Embassy in Kathmandu is in touch with the project authorities to collect information, as communication links in the affected area have been disrupted. Mr Jaiswal said that the Indian authorities are making all possible efforts, in coordination with the Nepalese authorities, to establish contact with the stranded Indians and ensure their safety.Mr Jaiswal said that India has sent more than 47 tonnes of emergency relief supplies aimed at supporting Nepal’s ongoing rescue and relief operations. He said that India is also mobilising Bailey bridges to assist in rescue and relief efforts. Mr Jaiswal said that government has set up a control room in the Ministry of External Affairs, which will function round the clock. He said, Indian embassies, both in Kathmandu and Beijing, have also set up 24 X 7 helplines.Mr Jaishwal said that Prime Minister Narendra Modi had yesterday spoken to his Nepalese counterpart and conveyed deepest condolences over the loss of lives. He assured that India stands in solidarity with the people of Nepal and offered all possible humanitarian assistance.On the Indian national stranded in Chinese side, Mr Jaiswal that Indian Embassy in Beijing is making all efforts for their safe evacuation. He said, there are approximately 200 Indian nationals, who have sought assistance for evacuation. Of the stranded Indians, 95 are in Darchen and are currently proceeding to Hilsa to cross over into Nepal. Besides, four are in Geelong City, 13 in Zuthulpuk, and they are en route to the town of Saga, while 60 to 70 others are also heading towards Saga. He said, Indian mission is in touch with the local authorities, and they are doing their best for their rescue and evacuation.

. UN Secretary-General Antonio Guteress has expressed grief over the loss of lives and the damage caused by the flash floods in Nepal and Tibet. Spokesman for the Secretary-General, Stephane Dujarric, said that the UN is supporting the government-led response and urgent assistance. Guteress extended condolences to the families of the victims and wished a swift recovery to those injured. The UN Secretary-General expressed his solidarity with all those affected.

. In Nepal, nearly 160 people have been killed and over 750, including 133 Indian nationals, remain missing after a massive flash flood swept through central Nepal yesterday.Originating in Tibet, the flood devastated several towns and villages, washing away critical bridges and crippling a dozen hydropower projects. Nepal Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal told the parliament that an earthquake hit the Tibet region at 8:37 am (local time) and the flash floods were reported three minutes later, suggesting a glacial outburst due to tremors, which triggered the floods.Nepal’s National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority said the massive flood entered the Trishuli River through the Bhote Koshi in Timure, a border town in Rasuwa district, due to the rockslide and swelling of the Lhende River situated along the Nepal-Tibet border. It then spread along the river course to other districts like Nuwakot, Chitwan, Gorkha, Tanahu and Nawalparasi East, covering areas ranging to nearly 2 hundred kilometres from the capital Kathmandu.The Nepal Police in a social media post said 157 people died in the flash flood. The Nepal government said around 500 people were missing. According to China’s state-run news channel, 3 people were dead and 265 were missing on the Chinese side of the border.Videos from the affected areas showed a powerful surge of muddy water, rocks and debris sweeping through the border region. Officials said that around 100 people have been rescued from different parts of the affected areas. Of them, 30 are undergoing treatment at Tribhuvan University Teaching Hospital in Kathmandu.Prime Minister Narendra Modi spoke to his Nepalese counterpart Balendra Shah and assured him of all possible humanitarian assistance. Mr Shah thanked Prime Minister Modi for his warm words of solidarity and for offering humanitarian assistance. New Delhi has already sent the first tranche of relief supplies to the neighbouring nation.The Indian Embassy in Kathmandu issued emergency numbers for assistance and information related to Indian nationals. The numbers are: +977 985 131 6807 and +977 970 910 7500. The Nepal Tourism Board also issued similar numbers, including the toll-free emergency number 1234, hotline 1144 and Tourist Police number 9851289445 for help.The Embassy of India in Beijing also issued a helpline number – 0086 185 1428 4905, which can also be contacted through WhatsApp. At least 50 of the Indians missing were pilgrims for the Kailash Manasarovar Yatra. Several Indian states – including Uttar Pradesh and Keralam have also issued helpline numbers.Other than the Indians and NRIs, the remaining missing tourists were from more than two dozen countries, including the US, Malaysia, the UK, South Africa, Australia and the Netherlands. Foreign Minister of Nepal, Shisir Khanal, informed the House of Representatives that 80 security personnel, including 44 Nepal Army personnel, have gone missing from various locations.The flash flood damaged eight operational hydropower projects with a total capacity of 354 megawatts and five under-construction projects located in the Nuwakot and Rasuwa districts. Nineteen motorable bridges have been washed away. Nepalese Army, Armed Police Force and Nepal Police personnel have been mobilised in the affected areas to carry out rescue and relief work.Chinese President Xi Jinping ordered all-out efforts to search for and rescue missing people. A total of 145 officers and soldiers from the Xigaze detachment of the People’s Armed Police have been sent to the affected border port to assist with emergency response operations. Mr Xi also stressed the need to strengthen monitoring and early warning, ensure scientific rescue operations and guard against secondary disasters.  Nepalese President Ramchandra Paudel has expressed sorrow over the loss of lives and property due to the flash flood.

. In Men’s Cricket, hosts Sri Lanka were 163 for two against India in their second innings of the Colombo Test, when reports last came in. India enforced the follow-on after bowling Sri Lanka out for 290 in their first innings. Resuming the penultimate day at 265 for 8, Sri Lanka managed to add only 25 runs.All-rounder Sonal Dinusha struck his second consecutive century, scoring 103 runs. For India, Prasidh Krishna and Manav Suthar took three wickets each, while Saransh Jain claimed two wickets.India declared their first innings at 503, powered by centuries from Dhruv Jurel and Devdutt Padikkal. India is currently leading the two-match series 1-0.

. The Government has commenced calibrated and targeted release of onions from the buffer stock to ensure adequate availability and moderate seasonal price pressures in the coming months.The Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and  Public Distribution has said that onion availability is comfortable to meet domestic demand in the coming months, as estimated production of onions for 2025-26 is over 307 Lakh Metric Tonnes (LMT). It added that in view of the comfortable production outlook, the Government has fixed a procurement target of two lakh metric tonnes of Rabi onion for the Price Stabilisation Fund (PSF) buffer during 2026-27.The procurement operation commenced on the 15th of May and around 1.21 LMT of onions have been procured for the buffer. The Ministry added that onions will be sold at 35 rupees per kilogram through mobile vans and retail outlets of the National Cooperative Consumers Federation (NCCF) and the National Agricultural Cooperative Marketing Federation (NAFED), as well as through Safal and Kendriya Bhandar outlets.The Ministry said the first Kanda Express has left Nashik and is expected to reach Delhi NCR with about 800 metric tonnes of onions late evening today or by tomorrow morning. Simultaneously, supplies are being moved through road transport to other major consumption centres across the country.

. US lawmakers today reintroduced legislation aimed at tightening sanctions on China-based entities accused of supporting the production, trafficking and sale of fentanyl and its precursor chemicals. The bipartisan CCP Fentanyl Sanctions Act was reintroduced by the House Select Committee on China, as Washington steps up pressure on Beijing over its alleged role in America’s opioid crisis.The bill targets Chinese chemical manufacturers, online vendors and other entities accused of profiting from the illicit synthetic narcotics trade. It would allow sanctions against Chinese vessels and ports found to have knowingly or recklessly facilitated the transportation of illicit synthetic narcotics. Lawmakers also pointed to a 2024 Select Committee report, which alleged that the Chinese Communist Party subsidised the production of fentanyl precursor chemicals that were later sold to Mexican drug cartels.
. In the Indian bullion market today, 24 carat gold was marginally down at 1,62,041 rupees per 10 grams while, Silver dropped 1.4 per cent to 2,41,848 rupees per kilogram.

. Grand Master Trilok Subba from Sikkim has been selected to represent India at the World Taekwondo Poomsae Championship. Akashvani correspondent reports that internationally acclaimed Taekwondo player Grand Master Trilok Subba, from Sikkim, has been selected to represent India at the World Taekwondo Poomsae Championship in Chuncheon, South Korea.The Championship is scheduled to take place from 16th to 20th September. Subba will compete in the Under-60 Male Individual Poomsae and team events in the Senior category. Prior to this selection, Subba clinched a gold medal for the National Team at the National Taekwondo Poomsae Championship held in Maharashtra in July 2026. Mr Subba will leave Sikkim shortly to join the National Camp in Maharashtra & then he will travel to South Korea for the Championship.

. The Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) has achieved a major milestone in its nationwide mission-mode drive for Mandatory Biometric Updates, completing more than two crore biometric updates for school children across the country. The special drive, initiated in September last year, has now covered over one lakh 56 thousand schools, enabling school children to complete their Aadhaar biometric. Electronics and IT Ministry said that this has helped Mandatory Biometric Updates service to reach children directly at their schools, making the process more accessible and convenient for crores of students.Aadhaar enrolment for children below five years captures demographic information and a photograph, while fingerprints and iris biometrics are not captured at that age as these biometrics are still developing. Mandatory Biometric Updates helps ensure that the child’s Aadhaar continues to have updated biometric information. The Biometric updates are required when a child attains the age of 5 years and again at 15 years. To encourage timely completion and make the service more accessible, UIDAI had waived the charges for  children in the 7 to 15 years age group from 1st October 2025, for a period of one year. The Ministry said that lack of Biometric Updates in Aadhaar may lead to difficulties while carrying out authentication for receiving benefits under various Government schemes, registering in competitive and university examinations.

. The government has reiterated its commitment to reimagining skills, saying it is taking all measures to skill youth and prepare them for future growth with a vision to achieve Viksit Bharat by the year 2047. NITI Aayog released a report titled Reimagining Skilling for Viksit Bharat@2047 which provides a blueprint for a skilling architecture.NITI Aayog said that in certain sections, the figure of 8.7 crore NEET youth has been misinterpreted as unemployed. It said that the category of NEET in the report refers to those not seeking employment and therefore, it cannot be read as a measure of joblessness or as an addition to the unemployment rate. NITI Aayog stressed that the Report has clearly said that the database utilised in computation of these figures is based on National Sample Survey, NSS 78th Round which was collected during the COVID-19 pandemic.

. The Union Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports is organising ‘Khelo India Samvad – Khel Ki Baat PM Ke Saath’ in two colleges in every district of Punjab and Haryana and the Union Territory of Chandigarh on August 27 with an aim to connect youth with the national vision of sports, fitness and youth-led nation building. The Samvad will be organized by Mera Yuva Bharat (MY Bharat) of the Department of Youth Affairs of the Ministry.Sharing details during a press conference in Chandigarh, today, State Director, MY Bharat Punjab, Rashmeet Kaur informed that students and youth will join the nationally synchronised programme from these venues and listen to the virtual address of Prime Minister, Narendra Modi. This will be followed by local-level interaction with youth and other activities. Officials of Mera Yuva Bharat from Chandigarh and Haryana also addressed the media. Local sportspersons and public representatives will also participate, providing youth an opportunity to share their ideas, suggestions and aspirations.During the programme, youth will also be encouraged to register on the MY Bharat portal and will have the opportunity to submit their suggestions digitally through the MY Bharat Suggestions Box. The Viksit Bharat Young Leaders Dialogue (VBYLD) 2027 Quiz will also be promoted among the participants.

. India and China have reaffirmed their commitment to maintain peace and tranquility in the border areas and create an atmosphere for healthy and steady development of bilateral relations. The 25th Round of Talks between the Special Representatives (SR) of India and China on the Boundary Question was held in Beijing yesterday.Special Representative of China, Member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Director of the Office of the Central Commission for Foreign Affairs Wang Yi and Special Representative of India and National Security Adviser Ajit Doval had a candid and in-depth exchange of views on the India-China boundary question and reached eight points of outcomes and consensus.The two sides underlined their commitment to advancing negotiations on a framework for the settlement of the boundary question. It will be in accordance with the Agreement on Political Parameters and Guiding Principles for Settlement of the India-China Boundary Question signed in 2005 and the consensus reached in subsequent SR Talks in pursuit of a fair, reasonable and mutually acceptable solution.The Expert Group on Boundary Delimitation and Working Group on Border Management under the Working Mechanism for Consultation and Coordination WMCC would respectively advance discussions on an Early and Substantial Harvest of boundary delimitation and Border Management. The first task for both these groups would be to agree on their respective Terms of Reference.India and China agreed that any situation on the ground would be addressed promptly through existing diplomatic and military channels, including the WMCC, local commander-level meetings and other agreed mechanisms, to resolve outstanding issues and avoid misunderstanding and miscalculation along the LAC.The two sides discussed ways to improve understanding of LAC in appropriate areas, for better border management. With the objective to improve the border management measures, an additional two meeting points were agreed for holding the General Level Mechanism or Senior Highest Military Commander meeting. Similarly two additional channels of border military hotline in the Eastern and Middle Sectors were agreed.Both sides noted the progress on trans-border cooperation. The Indian side appreciated the efforts made by the Chinese side to increase the number of batches of Indian official pilgrimage Kailash-Manasarovar Yatra in the Tibet Autonomous Region of China. Both sides appreciated the reopening of the three designated border trading points. The two sides agreed to strengthen exchanges and cooperation in border trade, pilgrimage and other areas, with the view to work together to create an atmosphere featuring dialogue, peace, consultation and cooperation in the border areas.The two sides also agreed to hold the next meeting of the India-China Expert-Level Mechanism on Trans-border Rivers next month and maintain communication on issues including hydrological data sharing, and renewal of the relevant MoUs. India and China agreed to hold the 26th round of SR Talks in India next year.

. Chemicals and Fertilisers Minister Jagat Prakash Nadda has emphasised that the Chemical sector has to touch one trillion-dollar vision by 2040 in the country. Addressing a high-level CEO Roundtable today in New Delhi, Mr Nadda said, the Government is committed to establishing a continuous and institutionalised dialogue mechanism with industry, with the objective of identifying impediments and translating suggestions into time-bound action. He said, It will require sustained investment, technology development, stronger domestic manufacturing capabilities. The Minister stated that under the visionary leadership of Prime Minister Narendra Modi, the Government continues to focus on creating an enabling ecosystem for investment, innovation, sustainability and long-term growth. He also assured that issues raised by the industry are duly noted and shall be suitably taken up relevant stakeholder Ministries.In her address, Minister of State of Chemicals and Fertilizers Anupriya Patel mentioned that Government has brought many reforms and launched schemes to promote manufacturing across the sectors including Chemical and Petrochemical sector such as Bhavya Rasayan, Coal Gasification, Rare Earth Corridors, Critical Mineral Mission, reforms including Tax reforms, Labour reforms. She assured that industry that the Government is committed to transition from a regulatory facilitator to an active growth partner, reducing administrative burden and ensuring the long-term viability of investments.Stressing the importance of government and industry partnership, Secretary Chemicals and Petrochemicals Tejveer Singh stated that the Chemicals sector offers major opportunities across given the expanding domestic demand across key downstream sectors. He emphasized the Department’s commitment to collaborating closely with industry leaders to shape future policy interventions.Speaking on the occasion, MD and CEO, Invest India Nivruti Rai, mentioned that India is well positioned to emerge as a preferred global destination for chemicals manufacturing, supported by its large domestic market, skilled talent, improving infrastructure and ongoing reforms.

. Parliamentary Affairs Minister Kiren Rijiju today emphasised that India must evolve its sporting traditions into a vibrant sports culture. Addressing the students participating in the Khelo India Dialogue at Hindu College in New Delhi, Mr Rijiju noted that under the leadership of Prime Minister Narendra Modi, the country is actively developing a strong sporting ecosystem.He said everyone should be engaged with sports to stay fit and build sportsmanship. Recalling his tenure as the Sports Minister, Mr Rijiju noted that during his visits to numerous sports camps, he observed that representing India was the shared dream of every athlete.

. On World Elephant Day, Minister of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Bhupender Yadav, today said that Project Elephant reflects India’s commitment to protecting elephants, conserving their habitats and promoting harmonious coexistence between elephants and communities. In a social media post, Mr Yadav said that under Project Elephant, various measures are being implemented, including early warning systems and AI-based alerts to keep communities informed, solar-powered fences and trenches to protect people and elephants, and timely compensation for crop losses suffered by farmers. He added that the railways are also adopting warning signals, AI-based solutions and speed restrictions in critical corridors to prevent elephant deaths. The Minister also said that the government is promoting education and awareness to encourage communities to live in harmony with elephants.

. Petroleum and Natural Gas Minister Hardeep Singh Puri today said that country is not merely a participant in the global energy landscape but is increasingly shaping it as the world’s third-largest consumer of energy and oil. The Minister said that India is the third-largest refiner and fourth-largest LNG importer. He said this while interacting with senior officers of the Indian Foreign Service.In a social media post, Mr Puri said that the country’s energy demand is expected to grow 2.5 times by 2047, accounting for around 25 percent of incremental global demand. The Minister underlined that transformative reforms have strengthened domestic capabilities, diversified energy sources, deepened strategic partnerships and accelerated country’s transition towards cleaner energy over the past decade under the leadership of Prime Minister Narendra Modi.

. In Men’s Cricket, Centuries by Dhruv Jurel and Devdutt Padikkal powered India to a hefty 503 for nine declared in their first innings against hosts Sri Lanka on a rain-disrupted second day of the second and final Test in Colombo. In reply, Sri Lanka were reduced to 8 for two at Stumps after pacer Prasidh Krishna and Manav Suthar gave marching orders to Lahiru Udara and Prabath Jayasuriya.For the visitors, Dhruv Jurel produced a flawless display of risk-free batting to score unbeaten 115. Devdutt Padikkal had provided the foundation with a commanding 117 yesterday. With the series already tilted 1-0 in India’s favour, the visitors have strengthened their position with a commanding total.Heavy rain brought an early end to the second session on day two’s play. High winds and darkening skies forced the umpires to halt play, leading to an early tea break. Earlier, India’s star batter Rishabh Pant shattered former skipper MS Dhoni’s record for most Test runs scored by an Indian wicketkeeper away from home. Pant scored a stroke-filled 63 to go past Dhoni. Pant has now scored 2534 runs as wicketkeeper away from home in Test cricket surpassing Dhoni’s 2,496 runs. The list is led by former Pakistan captain Sarfaraz Ahmed, who made 2696 runs away from home in 52 Tests. Australia legend Adam Gilchrist is second with 2634 runs in 41 Tests away from home or at neutral venues.

. Union Minister for Youth Affairs and Sports Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya has said the central government has sanctioned 36,000 crore rupees to build a robust sports ecosystem and infrastructure across the country.Speaking to the media on the sidelines of the ‘Khelo India Dialogue’ at IIT Gandhinagar in Palaj, Dr. Mandaviya emphasized that this fund will be utilized to establish sports academies, promote a vibrant sports culture, and strengthen infrastructure, ensuring that talented athletes from both rural and urban areas get opportunities to compete on global platforms.He added that under the leadership of Prime Minister Narendra Modi, a nationwide campaign is underway to boost youth participation in sports, reflecting the vision of a ‘Viksit Bharat’.
. In the forex market today, the rupee appreciated by 33 paise to close at 95.41 rupees against the US dollar.

. Indian Grandmaster R Praggnanandhaa cruised into the finals of the Grand Chess Tour’s last leg after 19-9 win over Germany’s Vincent Keymer. Having won the second Classical game, the Indian enjoyed a huge lead of six points coming into the final day on which games of shorter duration were played.He defeated Keymer in back-to-back rapid encounters to nearly seal his spot in the finals taking an unassailable 17-3 lead before another victory in the first game of blitz took his points tally to 19.Pragnanandhaa will take on pre-event favourite and defending champion Fabiano Caruana of the USA States in the event finale.The top three finishers will automatically qualify for next year’s Grand Chess Tour.

. The Indian Embassy in Kathmandu issued emergency numbers for assistance and information regarding Indian nationals affected by the flash floods in Nepal today. The Embassy said that people requiring assistance can contact the Embassy on helpline +977 985 131 6807 and +977 970 910 7500.The Embassy said, it has remained engaged with the relevant authorities of Government of Nepal for early rescue and relief for Indian nationals affected by the flash floods. It said rescue and relief efforts continue to be strengthened in coordination with the Government of Nepal.According to the official sources, India is preparing to send relief material as soon as possible to Nepal.The Tamil Nadu Government has announced a help desk for tourists from Tamil Nadu who have gone to visit Nepal. The Government has appealed to get in touch with the help desk and the State Department for Overseas Affairs. It said that help can also be sought from the Tamil Nadu House in New Delhi. Helplines numbers are 1800 309 3793 and 918069009900. Tamil Nadu House Delhi Help Desk number are 9289516712 and 9180 6900 9901.

. In the Asian markets, South Korea’s Kospi rose 0.7 per cent, and Japan’s Nikkei 225 added half a per cent today. In European markets, Germany’s DAX was trading 0.8 per cent up while, London’s FTSE 100 added 0.2 per cent, when reports last came in.

. In Hockey, the Indian Men’s team lost 3-5 to Argentina in a second-round pool match to crash out of the semifinal race of the FIH World Cup at Amstelveen in the Netherlands.For Argentina, Tomas Domene in 33rd and 45th minutes and Joaquin Toscani in 1st and 53rd minutes scored a brace each, while the other goal was scored by Nicolas della Torre in the sixth minute. India’s two goals were scored from field efforts by Sukhjeet Singh in the 34th minute and 58th minutes.As a consolation, India got a penalty stroke 36 minutes from the final hooter and Hardik Singh converted to reduce the margin of victory.Yesterday, Indian women’s team crashed out of Hockey World Cup after being held to a goalless draw by Australia in their final second-round match at Amstelveen.

. Union Minister Dr Jitendra Singh today informed that around 440 space technology startups are registered in India. In a written reply in Lok Sabha, Dr Singh said Indian National Space Promotion and Authorisation Centre, IN-SPACe has granted 113 authorisations to 52 Non-Government Entities, NGEs to carry out various space activities. Out of these, 18 NGEs are start-ups. The Minister said the Government has undertaken several proactive measures following the liberalization of the space sector. This is being done to promote participation of startups in satellite manufacturing, launch services, downstream applications and space-based technologies. IN-SPACe is facilitating the transfer of available ISRO technologies to industry while also identifying and consolidating the technology requirements of industry for future technology development and transfer. Till date, 118 Technology Transfer Agreements have been executed.

. Minister of State for Information and Broadcasting Dr L Murugan today said Government has established a Fact Check Unit in Press Information Bureau to mitigate fake news related to its programmes and policies. In a written reply in Lok Sabha, DR Murugan informed that the Fact Check Unit verifies claims relating to Government Ministries, Departments, PSUs and other Central Government organisations through a structured fact-checking process. It disseminates verified information through various platforms.The MoS further stated that Doordarshan and Akashvani further disseminate verified information through their news bulletins, programmes and digital platforms. DD News follows a multi-layered editorial mechanism involving rigorous fact-checking, cross-verification through multiple credible sources and editorial scrutiny before broadcast. PIB Fact Check content is regularly integrated into Doordarshan and Akashvani news and digital platforms to counter misinformation and false narratives.PIB, as the principal information dissemination agency of the Government, facilitates timely, credible and accurate communication in different forms through various media platforms. Prasar Bharati plays a key role in fulfilling the mandate of public service broadcasting. Information is disseminated in multiple languages, including regional languages and dialects, using various platforms.

. The Publications Division of the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting has received seven awards at the Federation of Indian Publishers (FIP) Awards for Excellence in Book Production, 2026. The Division’s journals, books and reference publications in Hindi, English and Urdu have been recognised in various categories.Director General, Publications Division, Dr. Dhiraj Kakadia said that the books and journals published by the Division play an important role in bringing diverse and valuable content related to national development, literature, culture, art and contemporary issues to readers. He said, the seven awards received by the Publications Division are a testament to the collective hard work, dedication and excellence of its officers and personnel.

. Haryana Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini honoured Commonwealth Games medallists and participants from Haryana at a state-level felicitation ceremony held in Panchkula today. Cash awards totalling ₹13 crore 97 lakh 50 thousand were presented to 24 athletes at the event.Expressing pride in the athletes’ achievements, the Chief Minister remarked that an athlete’s success is underpinned by the faith of their parents, the discipline instilled by their mentors, and the resolve to rise again after every defeat. He noted that India secured the fourth position on the medal tally at the 23rd Commonwealth Games, winning a total of 39 medals comprising 13 gold, 17 silver, and 9 bronze.Haryana once again distinguished itself during this glorious moment. He highlighted that while Haryana accounts for merely 2 percent of the country’s total population, athletes from the state clinched a total of 11 medals in these games.Commending the performance of the state’s daughters in particular, the Chief Minister pointed out that 6 of the 11 medals won by Haryana’s athletes were secured by women, including 5 gold medals. He expressed confidence that, driven by the prowess of its athletes, India would emerge as a global sporting powerhouse at the Olympic Games.

. The Report of the Inquiry Committee investigating allegations concerning former Allahabad High Court Judge Yashwant Varma was tabled in both the Houses of Parliament. In the Lok Sabha, Secretary General Uttpal Kuma Singh tabled the Hindi and English versions of the Report of the Inquiry Committee constituted under the Judges (Inquiry) Act, 1968 as well as the Oral and documentary evidence recorded during the course of the inquiry. While in the Rajya Sabha, the report in this regard was tabled by Secretary General P C Mody.The Judges Inquiry Committee, investigating allegations concerning Yashwant Varma, had submitted its report to the Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla in May this year. The Committee was constituted by Mr Birla on 12th of August last year to probe the allegations levelled against Justice Varma, after a sum of burnt cash was found at his official residence in New Delhi.

. The Tata Institute of Social Sciences, TISS, conferred degrees on 1,376 students and scholars at its 86th annual convocation held in Mumbai yesterday.The degrees included those awarded to 35 doctoral scholars and graduates from Master’s, Bachelor’s, Integrated and dual-degree programmes.The first undergraduate batch of Analytics and Sustainability Studies also received their degrees. Director of Tata Memorial Hospital, Dr C. S. Pramesh, was the chief guest at the convocation.

. The Trump administration has paused all immigrant visa applications across the world. The move comes as the US State Department aims to tighten restrictions and limit access to applicants who may become dependent on US public benefits reserved for qualified Americans. Quoting State Department officials, the media reports said, the US is training consular officers to evaluate such requests comprehensively and consistently.The pause comes as the US has launched a crackdown against illegal immigration and also tightened rules governing the issuance of green cards. A day before, the Trump administration had proposed a new 1 lakh 3 thousand 2 hundred 65 US Dollar application fee for H-1B visas.The H-1B visa is a non-immigrant visa that allows US companies to employ foreign workers in speciality occupations that require theoretical or technical expertise. Technology companies depend on it to hire tens of thousands of employees each year from countries like India and China.

. Benchmark domestic equity indices ended in negative territory today. The Sensex declined 539 points or 0.70 per cent to close at 76,934. The Nifty lost 117 points or 0.48 per cent to settle at 24,091. In the broader market at the National Stock Exchange, the Midcap 100 index and the Smallcap 100 index dipped 0.1 per cent each.

. Indian football club East Bengal entered the main draw of the AFC Women’s Champions League 2026-27 by beating Malaysia’s Sabah Football Club 2-0 in their final Group A preliminary-stage match in Kota Kinabalu, today. The win helped East Bengal earn successive group stage qualification in the AWCL.East Bengal now have both their men’s and women’s teams competing in the AFC group stages in the same season. The men’s team, who won the Durand Cup today, will compete in the AFC Champions League Two 2026-27 main stage. East Bengal will now enter a separate draw in September, with matches set to begin in November. The 12 teams in the main draw will be divided into three groups of four for the AFC Women’s Champions League 2026-27 season.

. Road Transport and Highways Minister Nitin Gadkari has stressed that futuristic planning and vision are crucial for ensuring sustainable development in the country.Addressing the 21st Global Sustainability Summit through video conferencing today, Mr Gadkari emphasised the need for cooperation, coordination and communication among all stakeholders working towards India’s sustainable development. He said challenges should be converted into opportunities through proper planning and a clear vision.The Minister said economic development requires a futuristic vision for industry, trade, business, agriculture and tourism. He said development projects should be cost-effective, pollution-free, indigenous and aimed at reducing dependence on imports.

. The Baloch Yakjehti Committee (BYC) today accused Pakistani security forces of enforced disappearances, arbitrary detentions, and forced evictions in the Shadi Kor area of Balochistan. In a statement, the rights organization alleged that in May this year, personnel from the Pakistani Army and Military Intelligence rounded up residents and detained a large number of people.The BYC claimed those detained were subjected to violence and degrading treatment, with around 40 people allegedly forcibly disappeared and taken to a military camp near the Shadi Kor Dam. According to the BYC, people returning home with food and other rations have been stopped at checkpoints, while road blockades have made it difficult for residents to obtain basic necessities. The Baloch rights group also called on international human rights organizations, United Nations bodies, and the international community to investigate the allegations.

. President Droupadi Murmu has conveyed sympathies to Nepalese President Ramchandra Paudel and the people of Nepal on the devastation caused by the flash floods today.In a social media post, the President expressed solidarity with Nepal at this difficult hour. President Murmu said that India stands ready to support the relief and rescue efforts of the Nepal Government for those affected by this calamity.Vice President CP Radhakrishnan today expressed grief over the loss of lives and devastation caused by the flash floods in Nepal.In a social media post, Mr Radhakrishnan conveyed his condolences to the bereaved families and prayed for the speedy recovery of those injured. He also prayed for the safe and swift rescue of all those who are missing. Mr Radhakrishnan said that the thoughts of the people of India are with the people of Nepal during this difficult hour.Prime Minister Narendra Modi spoke to his Nepalese counterpart Balendra Shah and conveyed condolences on the loss of lives due to the floods in Nepal.In a social media post, Mr Modi said, the people of India stand in solidarity with their sisters and brothers in Nepal at this difficult time. He said, India is ready to provide all possible humanitarian assistance to Nepal. The Prime Minister said, our teams are coordinating closely on rescue and relief efforts.India has dispatched 10 tonnes of Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief and essential medicines to support Nepal which faced devastating floods today.In a social media post, External Affairs Minister Dr S Jaishankar, said that India stands with Nepal and its people in the face of this challenge. He said that his thoughts are with the bereaved families and all those affected by the floods.

. Ahead of Independence Day, a platform for creative expression has been provided to the youth in Uttar Pradesh. For this, the ‘Rang De Basanti’ campaign was launched. Under this campaign, the graffiti wall programme organised near Lucknow University today. Artists from the city painted public murals on the theme of a mafia-free and changing Uttar Pradesh. Through these paintings, the Uttar Pradesh of before 2017 and the changes that have taken place in Uttar Pradesh thereafter were portrayed.On the wall, artists used their colours and imagination to portray in paintings the changed positive environment in the state in terms of law and order, infrastructure and opportunities for youth. Young painter Manish Saroj’s painting expressed the pain of Uttar Pradesh suffering under mafia rule before 2017, while also presenting a positive picture of the change taking place now.Under the campaign, a comic distribution and dialogue programme will be organised in Muzaffarnagar tomorrow. During this, an original comic based on communal harmony will be distributed. Along with this, dialogues will also be held with youth in schools. On August 14, the song ‘Azadi from Fear’ of the ‘Rang De Basanti’ campaign will be launched. It will also feature a confluence of rap, music and digital art.

. India and the United States have today discussed developments in bilateral civil nuclear cooperation and ways to further strengthen ties in the sector.Atomic Energy Commission Chairman Ajit Kumar Mohanty met US Energy Secretary Chris Wright in Washington ahead of the launch of the International Atomic Energy Agency’s Atomic Technologies Licensed for Applications at Sea initiative.The initiative will explore the use of small modular reactors to power civilian ships and provide offshore energy.

. All India Institute of Ayurveda (AIIA), New Delhi has introduced a new course titled GARBHINI MITRA to Strengthen Ayurveda-Based Maternal Wellness Support for the 2026-2027 academic session.The Ministry of AYUSH said that the six-month course is designed to develop trained personnel to provide appropriate health education, lifestyle guidance, and community-level support to women during pregnancy and the postnatal period.The ministry noted that Candidates of 18 years or above, who have passed the Senior Secondary examination from any recognized board are eligible to apply before its last date that is 31st August.Once completed, candidates can work as Garbhini Mitra Assistants, Prenatal or Postnatal Care Assistants, Antenatal Wellness Guides and Maternal Health Support Workers, across different Ayush centres, maternity clinics and wellness institutions.The course inculcates traditional ayurvedic concepts of Garbhini Paricharya, Sutika Paricharya and Garbhadhana Vidhi.

. The Unified Payments Interface (UPI) has completed ten years of transforming digital payments and has emerged as the backbone of India’s digital payments ecosystem. The UPI, which was launched on 25th August 2016, has surged almost 13 thousand fold in transaction volume. The Finance Ministry said that the annual transaction volume expanded from just 1.78 crore transactions in 2016-17 to over 24 thousand 162 crore transactions in 2025-26. The transaction value also rose sharply from seven thousand crore to nearly 314 lakh crore during the same time period. The Ministry said that UPI has also emerged as a global platform for cross-border digital payments and is currently operational in 11 countries. These are United Arab Emirates, France, Bhutan, Sri Lanka, Nepal, Singapore, Mauritius, Qatar, Cambodia, Greece and Maldives.UPI has emerged as one of the most successful pillars of India’s Digital Public Infrastructure, providing an interoperable, real-time payments platform. Today, it is the preferred mode of payment for millions of users, transforming the way India transacts. By bridging the digital divide, advancing financial inclusion, and expanding access to digital financial services, UPI has empowered individuals and communities across the country while driving broad-based economic participation. The unprecedented scale and reliability achieved by UPI have received global recognition. It said, the International Monetary Fund has acknowledged it as the world’s largest real‑time payment system. As of 2025, UPI accounts for nearly 49 per cent of the world’s real-time payment transaction volume.

. India has dispatched the second tranche of the 37.5 tonnes of Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief material, medicines and food packets for Nepal. The humanitarian assistance to the neighbouring nation is being provided after it was hit by flash floods on Wednesday.In a social media post, External Affairs Minister Dr S Jaishankar informed that the second flight has taken off carrying relief materials. He said, India remains in close and continuous touch with the Nepalese authorities and it will continue to strongly support the ongoing relief efforts.India had yesterday dispatched 10 tonnes of Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief and essential medicines to support the people of Nepal.

. Meta has agreed to pay 18 billion US Dollars and add stronger child-safety measures to its Facebook and Instagram platforms. The move comes as part of a landmark legal settlement that ended a trial over teen social media addiction and settled claims filed by 47 states.If approved by the court, the deal will stop an avalanche of litigation by states against Meta, although the company still faces lawsuits from individuals and school districts across the US. Meta said that ensuring teens have a safe and productive experience on our platforms is an absolute imperative for the company. It also urged rivals TikTok and YouTube to adopt similar safety measures.The agreement cuts short an ongoing court case involving California, Colorado, Kentucky and New Jersey, which were among 29 states that sued Meta in 2023. The lawsuit accused Meta of contributing to the youth mental health crisis by deliberately designing features that addict children to its platforms and hiding them from the public. The case also argued that Meta violated federal laws by routinely collecting data on children under 13 without their parents’ consent.

. In Chess, India’s 19-year-old Grandmaster Pranesh M emerged as the champion in the prestigious Kanizsa Open 2026 in Nagykanizsa, Hungary, securing the Group A title with a superb performance. In the ninth and final round of the tournament, Pranesh defeated Vadim Petrovskiy of Germany with white pieces. Pranesh has a rating of 2673 and is ranked 44th in the latest FIDE Rankings of August 2026.Pranesh, who hails from Karaikudi in Tamil Nadu, finished with seven points from nine rounds, sharing the top spot with three other players. He claimed the title on a better tiebreak with Or Bronstein of Israel, Andrei Volokitin of Ukraine, and India’s Karthik Venkataraman, finishing second to fourth in that order. The Indian Embassy in Hungary hailed Pranesh for winning the title.

. The death toll in the massive flash floods in Nepal today rose to 270, as authorities in Nepal race against time to find thousands of missing people, including 288 Indian tourists, in one of the country’s worst disasters in recent years. The flash floods yesterday wreaked havoc across three districts in Nepal. Nepal Police said that 93 more bodies were recovered today.According to Nepal Police spokesperson Abi Narayan Kafle, the bodies recovered so far include 108 in Chitwan, 62 in Nawalparasi East, 27 in Dhading, 20 in Gorkha, 17 in Rasuwa, 15 in Nawalparasi West, 12 in Nuwakot, and nine in Tanahun.Authorities in Tibet and Nepal have reported over 1,300 people missing as of today, out of these, many were foreigners. Both authorities reported that people from more than 30 countries are missing, mainly from India, the United States, Malaysia, Ukraine, Australia, Britain, Canada, South Korea, Singapore, Germany and Russia.Nepal Police spokesperson Kafle said, over 800 stranded people, including those injured, have been rescued from the affected areas, so far.The flash floods were caused after an avalanche blocked the flow of the Lhende tributary of the Bhotekoshi and first hit Timure, near Nepal’s border with China at Rasuwagadhi.

. In Men’s Cricket, India remain in a strong position in the second and final Test against Sri Lanka in Colombo, despite rain threatening to disrupt the final day’s play.Sri Lanka’s Sonal Dinusha has brought up his half-century and, along with Keshara Nuwantha, is continuing to resist India’s bowling attack.The hosts were 229 for six, with a 16-run lead, when play on the fourth day was brought to an early end by rain yesterday. Pasindu Sooriyabandara scored 92 and shared an important partnership with Kamindu Mendis. However, India struck back in the final session, taking three wickets and restricting Sri Lanka’s lead.Earlier, India enforced the follow-on after bowling Sri Lanka out for 290 in their first innings. Prasidh Krishna and Manav Suthar claimed three wickets each, while Saransh Jain took two. India had declared their first innings at 503, with centuries from Dhruv Jurel and Devdutt Padikkal. India lead the two-match series 1-0.

. Union Home and Cooperation Minister Amit Shah will chair a high-level review meeting at the Circuit House Annexe in Ahmedabad to assess preparations for the upcoming Olympic and Commonwealth Games. The Home Minister will also grace the 72nd Convocation Ceremony of Gujarat Vidyapith as the Chief Guest and address the students.Earlier, on reaching Gujarat today, the Home Minister inaugurated the newly constructed Gujarat Gaurav Lake, constructed jointly by Dholakiya Foundation and Harikrishna Group at Dudhala in Amreli district.Speaking on the occasion, the Home Minister said since Narendra Modi assumed office as the Chief Minister of Gujarat, the state has witnessed unprecedented progress in water conservation and management. Through a massive public-participation model, a record one point five lakh check dams were constructed in a single year during 2003.This dedicated effort expanded the state’s irrigation capacity sixteen-fold, transforming Gujarat’s agricultural landscape and empowering farmers across drought-prone regions. The minister also lauded the massive water conservation work of the Dholakiya Foundation in the Saurashtra region.In the evening, the Minister is also scheduled to attend the RV Patel Pharminnova Awards 2026 organised by Troika Pharmaceuticals in Thaltej, followed by a ‘Lok Darbar’ at Bopal in the Ghatlodia constituency to interact with residents.

. The Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana will complete 12 years tomorrow, marking a significant milestone in transforming India’s financial inclusion landscape.The scheme was launched by Prime Minister Narendra Modi on 28th August 2014. The Finance Ministry said that under the scheme, more than 59 crore accounts have been opened so far, with total deposits amounting to three lakh seventeen thousand crore rupees. As the world’s largest financial inclusion initiative, Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana continues to redefine access to banking for all Indians. The average deposit per account is five thousand 356 rupees.Minister of State for Finance Pankaj Chaudhary informed that under the scheme 78 per cent of the accounts have been opened in rural or semi-urban areas, and approximately 56 per cent of accounts are owned by women. He said, it has also empowered millions, particularly the marginalized sections, to access banking and financial services to improve their socio-economic conditions.

. The National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) has issued a notice to the Chief Secretary of Maharashtra over the reported death of three newborns and injuries to four others due to a fire incident at the Sick Newborn Care Unit of the District Women’s Hospital at Amravati, Maharashtra. Taking suo motu cognizance of a media report, the Commission has sought a detailed report in the matter within two weeks. The Commission has observed that if the contents of the news report are true, then it raises a serious issue of violation of human rights. According to the media report, the incident took place on 25th of this month.

. The government has lifted export restrictions on wheat flour and related products, opening the way for overseas shipments of atta, maida, semolina and other wheat-based products. According to the notification issued by the Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT), the government has amended the export policy for wheat flour and related products, with immediate effect.In a separate notification issued by DGFT, the government has also changed the export policy for specified wheat and durum wheat categories from prohibited to free.

. Global crude oil prices declined over three per cent today. Brent crude was trading 3.4 per cent down at 89 US dollars and one cent per barrel in intra-day trade. West Texas Intermediate crude was trading 3.6 per cent lower at 81 US dollars and 94 cents per barrel, when reports last came in.
